headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 19, 2026**
article:
The Boston Red Sox dominated the Tampa Bay Rays in a 10-0 shutout victory, with Carlos Narváez leading the Red Sox offense with 3 hits, including a home run, and 3 RBIs. In another matchup, the Los Angeles Dodgers secured a narrow 2-1 victory over the New York Yankees, with Max Muncy delivering a crucial home run. The Atlanta Braves also secured a decisive win, dominating the Texas Rangers 15-1.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Justin Sterner (Athletics) who was placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right knee chondromalacia. Other notable injuries include Lourdes Gurriel Jr. (Arizona Diamondbacks) with a right adductor strain, and Oneil Cruz (Pittsburgh Pirates) who was transferred to the 60-day injured list with left hand fourth and fifth metacarpal non-displaced fractures.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place, including the Chicago Cubs acquiring Aaron Civale from the Athletics in exchange for Aiden Moffett. The Baltimore Orioles also acquired Rudy Martin Jr. from the Kansas City Royals in a cash deal. The St. Louis Cardinals traded for Trey Pooser from the Tampa Bay Rays, and the Pittsburgh Pirates acquired Robert Hassell III from the Washington Nationals in a cash deal.

top_news.title: **Rays Suffer 10-0 Shutout Loss to Red Sox**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox dominated the Tampa Bay Rays in a 10-0 victory, handing the Rays their latest loss. Carlos Narváez led the Red Sox offense with 3 hits, including a home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rays Fall to Red Sox in 3-5 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox secured a 3-5 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays, handing the Rays their loss. Wilyer Abreu led the Rays' offense with 2 hits and 2 home runs, while Aroldis Chapman earned the save for the Red Sox with 2 strikeouts in 1 inning of work.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Edge Yankees 2-1 in Thrilling Matchup**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers secured a narrow 2-1 victory over the New York Yankees, with Max Muncy delivering a crucial home run in the game. Muncy's 18th home run of the season came on a fly ball to right field, scoring Mookie Betts in the process.

top_news.title: **Braves Rout Rangers in Blowout Victory**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves dominated the Texas Rangers 15-1, securing a decisive win. Chris Sale led the Braves' pitching effort, throwing 7.0 innings with 6 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Cruise Past Guardians 7-1**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates dominated the Cleveland Guardians in a decisive 7-1 victory, with several players making significant contributions on both sides of the ball. Impact hitters for the Pirates included Bryan Reynolds and Nick Gonzales, while Brandon Lowe and Steven Kwan led the Guardians' offense.

top_news.title: **Cubs Cruise Past Twins 6-2**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured a 6-2 victory over the Minnesota Twins, with several players making significant contributions to the win. Taj Bradley stood out among the Cubs' pitchers, while Kody Clemens and Seiya Suzuki were among the key performers for the Twins.

top_news.title: **Athletics' Justin Sterner Lands on 15-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Athletics right-handed pitcher Justin Sterner has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right knee chondromalacia diagnosis. This move comes after a recent medical evaluation.

top_news.title: **Cubs Acquire Aaron Civale in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs have acquired right-handed pitcher Aaron Civale in a trade with the Athletics. Civale joins the Cubs after being dealt for right-handed pitcher Aiden Moffett.
